command_line:
set -eu
cat > fit_age_logit.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
outfile <- args[[2]]
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(readxl))
d <- read_excel(infile, sheet = 1)
if (!("Age" %in% names(d))) stop("Age column not found")
if (!("Efficacy" %in% names(d))) stop("Efficacy column not found")
age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["Age"]]))
eff <- toupper(trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]])))
response <- ifelse(eff %in% c("CR", "PR"), 1L, ifelse(eff %in% c("SD", "PD"), 0L, NA_integer_))
model_data <- data.frame(response = response, age = age)
model_data <- model_data[stats::complete.cases(model_data), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(model_data) == 0) stop("No complete rows for model")
if (length(unique(model_data$response)) != 2) stop("Response is not binary after coding")
fit <- stats::glm(response ~ age, family = stats::binomial(link = "logit"), data = model_data)
coefs <- summary(fit)$coefficients
result <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(coefs),
  estimate = coefs[, "Estimate"],
  std_error = coefs[, "Std. Error"],
  z_value = coefs[, "z value"],
  p_value = coefs[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  n = nrow(model_data),
  events = sum(model_data$response == 1),
  nonevents = sum(model_data$response == 0),
  event_definition = "CR/PR=1;SD/PD=0",
  formula = "response~age",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(result, file = outfile, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
